items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I loved her and she's a very good friend of mine

ctx.x: Yes, I recorded with her. She was a great favorite of John Hammond's, you know. Mildred asked me to do an engagement with her at the 18th Hole on 52nd Street, so that's where we were in the summer of '52 with George Auld's band. It was a terrific engagement except Mildred used to become disturbed. There was a girl that used to be in New York - Stella Brooks, did you ever hear of her? Stella Brooks was a very good singer and very good actress.
